title: post-poc-stakeholder-heatmap-and-ops-runbook
summary: Concise executive readout for the Atlas POC (3-week pilot). Contains a stakeholder heatmap (influence vs. adoption risk), topline technical and business outcomes, a 90-day action runbook for converting POC to Dedicated deployment, and an ops runbook for first-24-hours production smoke checks. Purpose: align CS, product, SRE, and the customer on concrete next steps and owners.
outcomes: Functional: End-to-end API integration completed; prefix caching enabled; mean token latency improved for 1k token examples.
Business: Customer-facing NPS spike in initial demo cohort; internal estimate shows ~18% per-call cost improvement with batching and KV cache.
Operational: Deployment prototype ran for 48 hours with automated fallback to smaller quantized model under load; no data exfiltration events observed.
key_metrics: Throughput observed: 85 RPS on dedicated pilot pool (2x baseline)
Token cost delta vs baseline: -18% (projected with caching + batching)
Error rate (5xx): 0.6% during peak stress window
critical_risks: Integration: Customer's legacy auth flow requires header rewriting; current workaround is an edge proxy that adds 30ms and is not yet approved by their security.
Scale: Autoscaling thresholds are conservative; sudden 3x traffic spike could trigger fallback to a smaller model with degraded QA if not tuned.
Compliance: Customer requires CMEK for embeddings storage in Dedicated; we need legal review and KMS integration before shipment.
Cost: Unit economics assume 60% cache hit rate; if production patterns differ (shorter prefixes), cost improvements drop below threshold for renewals.

rollout_timeline: Phase 0 (now-2 weeks): Security & auth blockers resolution. Phase 1 (2-6 weeks): Dedicated staging deploy, autoscaler tuning, SRE runbook. Phase 2 (6-12 weeks): Canary production rollout at 10% traffic, monitor KPIs, escalate rollback if P95 > 750ms or token cost > projected +20%. Phase 3 (12+ weeks): Full cutover and formal SOW signoff.
ops_runbook_snippets: First-24-hours smoke checklist: endpoint ping, KV cache warmup (run warmup script), run synthetic conversation at 1RPS then ramp to 20RPS
Alert thresholds to seed: P95 latency > 650ms for 5m, 5xx rate > 1% for 10m, cache hit ratio < 40% for 15m
Rollback ladder: 1) reduce concurrency to preserve tail latency, 2) fallback to quantized model v1.3, 3) redirect 20% traffic to hosted fallback endpoint
Incident postmortem template: timeline, root cause hypothesis, corrective actions, owners, SLA/contract impact assessment
